name: JustPush-Refactory
purpose: Deployment automation focused on making pushing code reliable and simple
purpose_id: Otomasi deployment dengan fokus membuat proses push kode andal dan mudah
insight: Deployment tooling is UX design — the happy path has to be one action
insight_id: Perkakas deployment adalah desain UX — alur ideal harus selesai dalam satu aksi

name: Aily Telegram Bot
insight: Bots are conversational UIs — flow design matters more than the API calls
insight_id: Bot adalah UI percakapan — desain alur jauh lebih penting daripada pemanggilan API

name: PaxPatronage
purpose: Crowd-fundraising platform built LAMP-style from scratch
purpose_id: Platform penggalangan dana publik yang dibangun bergaya LAMP dari nol
insight: No framework — auth, campaigns, and payments modeled by hand
insight_id: Tanpa framework — autentikasi, kampanye, dan pembayaran dirancang manual

name: Banker's Algorithm Visualizer
purpose: Interactive visualization of the OS deadlock-avoidance algorithm
purpose_id: Visualisasi interaktif algoritma pencegahan deadlock pada Sistem Operasi
insight: An algorithm you can poke teaches faster than one you read
insight_id: Algoritma yang bisa dipraktikkan mengajarkan lebih cepat dibanding yang dibaca

name: Hydrostatic Pressure Prediction
purpose: ML regression modeling of a physical system
purpose_id: Pemodelan regresi ML untuk sistem fisik
insight: Physics gives you a ground truth most ML datasets never have
insight_id: Fisika memberikan kebenaran acuan yang jarang dimiliki dataset ML biasa

name: Face Recognition
purpose: Classical face detection with Haar cascades, before deep learning
purpose_id: Deteksi wajah klasik dengan Haar cascades sebelum era deep learning
insight: Classical CV still wins when you have one webcam and no GPU
insight_id: CV klasik tetap unggul saat Anda hanya punya satu webcam tanpa GPU

name: PKM Company Profile
insight: Client-style work: the constraint is their content, not your stack
insight_id: Proyek gaya klien: batasan utamanya adalah konten mereka, bukan stack Anda
